# Imported coordinate constructions

These are canonical-unit copies of independently published constructions. Discovery credit, the original published scale, the frozen source URL and SHA-256 are retained in each JSON file. A copy is given the project's 1e-7 clearance and checked by both the float verifier and exact rational certifier; it is not presented as a new discovery by the importer.

| Author | Cases | Folder |
|---|---|---|
| Ryan Xu | Cubes in a cube, n = 34, 35, 36 | [cubincub](cubincub/) |
| Haowei Lin / Tencent Hunyuan | Cubes in a cube, n = 11, 12; octahedra in a cube, n = 21, 24 | [cubincub](cubincub/), [octincub](octincub/) |
| Yohei Nakajima | Cubes in a cube, n = 12 | [cubincub](cubincub/) |
| T. Berthold, D. Kamp, G. Mexi, S. Pokutta and I. Polik | Octahedra in a cube, n = 17 | [octincub](octincub/) |

Every JSON has accompanying `.certify.txt` and `.verify.txt` receipts. The site selects the smallest available certified coordinate copy or an explicitly labelled smaller source-only published entry; other coordinate constructions remain available in the viewer. Existing project record files are not replaced by this import.

The [source registry](../../docs/external_records.json) also includes catalogue constructions and an author report whose coordinates are unavailable. They have no files or certificates in this folder. See [normalization and attribution notes](../../docs/literature/external/README.md) for details.
